Lock food level for players in the lobby or spectator area.

There is no reason why food should be a thing in the lobby or spectator area. This commit effectively disables it for players in those places/states, while retaining the in-arena conditional logic based on the config-file setting.

Fixes #514

result.reasoning: Prior to this commit, the food level change handler checked `arena.inArena((Player) event.getEntity())` before applying the lockFoodLevel logic. This commit refactored the method to split logic between "arena running" and "lobby/spec" branches, but in doing so dropped the inArena check from the `arena.isRunning()` branch, causing the lockFoodLevel cancellation to apply to all players when the arena is running, regardless of whether they are actually in the arena. The fix commit fb5db894 restores this missing check by adding `arena.inArena(p) &&` back to the condition.
